message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules** *Uno* is a fast‑paced card game that’s easy to learn and fun for all ages. The goal is to be the first player to score 500 points (or a different agreed‑upon total). Points are earned by being the first to discard all of your cards in each round. --- ### 1. Setup | Step | Action | |------|--------| | 1 | Shuffle the Uno deck (108 cards). | | 2 | Deal 7 cards to each player. | | 3 | Place the remaining deck face‑down to form the draw pile. | | 4 | Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the discard pile. | | 5 | If the first card is a special card (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, or Wild Draw Four), apply its effect immediately (see “Special Cards” below). | --- ### 2. Gameplay | Turn | Action | |------|--------| | 1 | Starting from the player to the left of the dealer, play proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | 2 | On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top card on the discard pile. | | 3 | If you have no playable card, you must draw one card from the draw pile. | | 4 | If the drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | 5 | After playing a card, if you have **no cards left**, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. | | 6 | If you forget to say “UNO!” and another player notices before the next turn starts, you must draw two penalty cards. | --- ### 3. Special Cards | Card | Effect | |------|--------| | **Skip** | The next player loses their turn. | | **Reverse** | Reverses the direction of play. In a 2‑player game, it acts like a Skip. | | **Draw Two (+2)** | The next player draws two cards and loses their turn. | | **Wild** | You choose the color that the next player must match. | | **Wild Draw Four (+4)** | You choose the color, and the next player must draw four cards and lose their turn.
**Penalty:** If you suspect the previous player had a playable card of the current color, you can challenge them. If they prove you were right, they draw six cards instead of four. If they prove you were wrong, you draw six cards. | --- ### 4. Winning a Round | Condition | Points Awarded | |-----------|----------------| | You discard your last card | 0 points (you’re the winner of the round) | | Other players still have cards | Add up the values of all cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value
• Draw Two, Skip, Reverse = 20 points each
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each | --- ### 5. Winning the Game | Condition | Outcome | |-----------|---------| | First player to reach 500 points (or the agreed total) | Wins the game | | If a player reaches the target mid‑round, the round continues until all players have finished. The winner of that round gets the points. | --- ### 6. House Rules & Variations | Variation | Description | |-----------|-------------| | **Uno Attack** | Uses a special “Attack” card that triggers a button to randomly drop 0–5 cards onto the next player. | | **Uno Flip** | Adds a “Flip” card that flips the deck to a new side with different colors and higher point values. | | **Custom Decks** | Some groups use themed decks (e.g., Disney, Pokémon). Rules stay the same. | | **No “UNO” Rule** | Some players skip the “UNO” shout entirely for a quicker game. | | **Team Play** | Players pair up; partners sit opposite each other and share points. | --- ### 7. Common Mistakes to Avoid | Mistake | Why It’s Wrong | |---------|----------------| | Playing a card that doesn’t match the color or number | Illegal play; must draw a card. | | Forgetting to say “UNO!” | Penalty of drawing two cards if caught. | | Using a Wild Draw Four when you could play a normal card | Can be challenged; may result in a heavier penalty. | | Not following the direction after a Reverse | Misplays the order of turns. | --- ### 8. Quick Reference Cheat Sheet | Situation | What to Do | |-----------|------------| | **You have a playable card** | Play it. | | **You have no playable card** | Draw one. If playable, play it. | | **You’re down to one card** | Say “UNO!” before the next player starts. | | **You’re down to zero cards** | You win the round. | | **You’re challenged on a Wild Draw Four** | Show your hand. If you had a playable card, you draw six. If not, the challenger draws six. | --- Enjoy your game of Uno! Feel free to tweak the rules to suit your group’s preferences.
